author: GameTrailers
description: Meet Troy, the new Gatekeeper. His job is simple - close the gates at a desolate railway crossing for one month. This is his last chance to earn back his wife's trust. To prove he can stay sober. To become a better man. Join him at the Tower in the middle of nowhere. Help Troy fix his life. Check out the Trainwatch announcement trailer for this upcoming adventure life sim game. Trainwatch will be available on PC in 2026.
title: Trainwatch - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Demo Trailer for Sin & Siege, a roguelite city builder colony simulation game developed by Nova xPress. Players will fight to restore the circles of Hall by processing wretched souls, creating new demons, and amassing Sins in the process. The demo for Sin & Siege is launching on August 3 for PC (Steam).
title: Sin & Siege - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the latest JDM: Japanese Drift Master trailer for the racing sim game to see what to expect with the multiplayer events. Gear up and prepare your builds! 15 new multiplayer events are coming to JDM: Japanese Drift Master on PC. From highway sprints across the entire Guntama prefecture to drift contests around Haikama Lake and intense 1 vs. 1 touge duels at the Tofuna Skyline. The ultimate competitive playground awaits. Multiplayer events will be available in JDM: Japanese Drift Master on July 29, 2026.
title: JDM: Japanese Drift Master - Official Multiplayer Events Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Reveal Trailer for Dreamsend: Wintersong, a strategic turn-based tactical RPG developed by Anthony Nguyen. Players will explore a fantastical cyberpunk world to take on battles, harness new abilities, and lead a party to save Landamere City. Dreamsend: Wintersong is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Dreamsend: Wintersong - Official Reveal Trailer

description: Don't miss the 'A Memory for the Breakfast Table' Gameplay Video for Woodo, a cozy, relaxing wood diorama puzzle game developed by Tiny Monks Tales. Players can get a look at building a loved memory of breakfast through high-fidelity wood pieces. Create what the heart desires in Woodo, coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Woodo - Official 'A Memory for the Breakfast Table' Gameplay Video

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out The Horde of Gorak trailer for this upcoming pixel art incremental strategy game. Lead a growing orc horde in The Horde of Gorak. Build your settlement, recruit powerful warriors, research new technologies, cast devastating spells, and destroy human castles to rescue your captured Warchief. The Horde of Gorak will be available on PC.
title: The Horde of Gorak - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Early Access Launch Trailer for ZeroSpace, a sci-fi RTS RPG developed by Starlance Studios and Ironward. Players will traverse the far reaches of the galaxy to secure a new home for humanity. Take on alien factions, make key decisions, and seek space supremacy through human might. ZeroSpace is available now in Early Access for PC (Steam).
title: ZeroSpace - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Zyntaris is a roguelike survival game with co-op mode. Tear through thousands of enemies solo or with a friend. Unlock new heroes with unique abilities. Collect rare weapons and magical tomes, combine them, and discover insane synergies. Watch the Zyntaris launch trailer to see gameplay and what you can expect. Zyntaris is available now on PC.
title: Zyntaris - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss 'The Final Echoes' Gameplay Trailer for Forever Skies, a first-person post-apocalyptic survival game developed by Far From Home. Players can get a first look at new additions with the latest update, including enhanced Airship damage, new locations, combat encounters, and more. The Final Echoes update for Forever Skies is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Forever Skies - Official 'The Final Echoes' Gameplay Trailer

Players will take on a suite of fantastical enemies, including horned foxes, gigantic snails, and more, after a glitch permits the exploration of varying locales across space and time. MetaHustle One is launching on August 27 for PC (Steam).
title: MetaHustle One - Official Release Date Trailer

description: Don't miss the Blackarrow Class Reveal Trailer for Mistfall Hunter, an upcoming dark fantasy extraction shooter developed by Bellring Games. Players will take out enemies from afar with the Blackarrow Class, a warrior who specializes in bow-based combat. Take aim with a suite of different elemental and kinetic arrows as the Blackarrow Class in Mistfall Hunter, launching on July 29 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

Fight as the Mercenary in Mistfall Hunter, launching on July 29 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

author: GameTrailers
description:
Liquidation gets a new trailer showcasing gameplay, game features, and an early access release date. Watch the Liquidation early access release date trailer for this tactical RTS game. The new trailer shows the factions you can play as in early access, multiplayer and campaign mode, and more. Liquidation will be available in Steam Early Access on August 4, 2026.

Set in a shattered world where fantasy and science fiction collide, Liquidation is a tactical real-time strategy game centered on the struggle for Quenrium, a mysterious substance capable of sustaining life on a dying planet.
title: Liquidation - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Release Date Reveal Trailer for Sunset Summit, a co-op group climbing game developed by Joe Fender and Andrew Fender. Players will scale the highest of peaks with nothing but axes, ropes, and each other. Make use of delivery drones, climb with caution, and reach the summit to avoid a fatal fall into oblivion. Sunset Summit is launching on August 21 for PC (Steam).
title: Sunset Summit - Official Release Date Reveal Trailer

description: Potato Simulato: Together will be available on PC on August 3, 2026. Watch the Potato Simulato: Together release date trailer for this upcoming rage-inducing physics platformer where you control a potato through absurd obstacles. Fall, fail, scream… and try again.
title: Potato Simulato: Together - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Look For The Light Trailer for Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy, an upcoming third-person action-adventure game developed by Asobo Studio. Players can check out how Sophia's journey is aided by the power and utility of light for protection, problem-solving, and revelations of the way forward. Look for the light in Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy, launching on August 27 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy - Official Look For The Light Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at action-packed gameplay from Waterpunk in this launch trailer for the upcoming roguelite action game set in a post-apocalyptic water world. Shape your strategy by choosing which abilities shine by day and which awaken at night. Waterpunk will be available on PC on July 30, 2026.
title: Waterpunk - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest Kill the Shadow trailer for this upcoming detective RPG to see gameplay and get a peek at the story. Kill the Shadow will be available on PC via Steam on August 5, 2026.

Set within the divided streets of Dark Tide City, you step into the role of Lucas, a former detective haunted by both his past and the mysterious Shadow attached to his back, a supernatural entity capable of reconstructing the final moments of the dead. Rather than changing the past, Lucas uses the Shadow to observe and reconstruct crime scenes exactly as they occurred, piecing together evidence, exposing lies, and uncovering the sinister forces manipulating the city from the shadows.
title: Kill the Shadow - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: The Dracomundus Purgatory update brings full cross-play, the Dracomundus Purgatory endgame challenge, and a new category of equipment with the Voracious Weapons. Watch the latest Dragonkin: The Banished to see what to expect with the Dracomundus Purgatory update for the hack n' slash game. Dragonkin: The Banished is available now on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S. The Dracomundus Purgatory update is out now.
title: Dragonkin: The Banished - Official Dracomundus Purgatory Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the new Forever Skies cinematic trailer for this sci-fi first-person survival adventure game. The Final Echoes update is the third and concluding installment of the Echoes update series. The Echoes updates bring survival mechanics, gameplay improvements, new side quests, a redesigned airship damage system, new airship tools and devices, an airship electricity system, location variety overhaul, new enemies, and more. Forever Skies is available now on Xbox Series X/S, PC, and PlayStation 5 (PS5), alongside The Final Echoes update.
title: Forever Skies - Official Xbox Series X/S and 'The Final Echoes' Cinematic Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Prelude Dark Pain is available now in Steam Early Access. Check out the Prelude Dark Pain early access launch trailer for this tactical RPG set in a dark fantasy world. In Prelude Dark Pain, assume the role of a local blacksmith named Soren, lead an uprising against the Order of the Ashen Crusade and save a world ravaged by war.
title: Prelude Dark Pain - Official Steam Early Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
STALKER 2: Cost of Hope gets a new trailer and a release date. Watch the latest STALKER 2: Cost of Hope trailer for this upcoming expansion for the FPS game, which brings uncharted locations to explore, unexpected allies and enemies, powerful weapons, and a new story. STALKER 2: Cost of Hope will be available on PC, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) on August 20, 2026. Update 2.0, which features new content and improvements, will launch alongside the Cost of Hope expansion.

The longstanding conflict between the Zone’s leading factions — Duty and Freedom — takes a dramatic turn. As tensions rise and the fragile peace between them begins to unravel, the fate of the Zone hangs in the balance. 

In Cost of Hope, players once again step into the role of Skif — the protagonist of S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl — as a mysterious PDA signal draws him into events unfolding alongside the main game’s story. Explore uncharted locations, encounter unexpected allies and enemies, disco
title: STALKER 2: Cost of Hope - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss this first look at gameplay for Guns of Eschaton, an all new soulslike set against a Western inspired world from the mind of the late Viktor Antonov, former Art Director for Half-Life 2 and Dishonored. Wield classic Western weaponry such as revolvers and lever-action rifles, set specialised ammo for maximum damage and turn the tables on attacking enemies with parries and dodges. 
Guns of Eschaton coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Guns of Eschaton - Official Gameplay Demo
